chunks: And it was narrated that he said: “There is no issue with the earnings of the mourning woman if she speaks truthfully.”
And in another report, he said: “She makes it lawful by striking one of her hands upon the other.”

key_terms.النَّائِحَةِ: the mourning woman who laments the deceased
key_terms.تَسْتَحِلُّهُ: she makes it lawful for herself

ai.seo_question: Is the income of a mourning woman who performs lamentation permissible in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the earnings of a mourning woman engaged in lamentation. It indicates that such earnings are permissible when her lament is truthful, and another report describes hand-striking as the act through which she takes that payment lawfully.
